$comment: M0 has ZERO external dependencies on purpose: a fresh clone must build and test
offline in under a minute so CI can gate every push. Dependencies arrive per
milestone, behind the features below, and are pinned by tools/deps.lock.
name: vpn

crypto.description: Real cryptography: BoringSSL (X25519, ChaCha20-Poly1305, TLS 1.3, ML-KEM). Required from M1.

logging.description: Structured, non-allocating logging. Required from M1.

api.description: Control-plane HTTP/2 + JSON + PostgreSQL. Required from M3.

tests.description: GoogleTest + Google Benchmark for integration and performance suites.
